title: Leadly.ai — AI Lead Generation & Outreach Automation
keyResult: Validated complex outreach sequence triggers, rate limiting, and RBAC across 3 user tiers

overview.product: Leadly.ai is an intelligent B2B sales acceleration platform offering automated multi-step email outreach campaigns, contact enrichment, real-time lead qualification, and webhook integrations with third-party CRMs.
overview.role: Associate SQA Engineer handling campaign engine validation, API contract verification, permission matrices, and regression suites.

challenge: High-volume email sequence queues under concurrent lead import frequently triggered rate limit drops or sent duplicate outreach steps. Additionally, role-based permission boundaries between workspace Admins and SDRs leaked sensitive lead export actions.

testStrategy.scope: Campaign builder drag-and-drop, automated sequence execution, CSV lead ingestion & mapping, webhook payload delivery, and RBAC matrix.

sampleTestCases.title: Outreach Sequence Delay & Condition Branching
sampleTestCases.steps: Configure 3-step sequence: Step 1 Email, Wait 2 Days, Step 2 Follow-up if 'No Reply'. Advance mock timestamp.
sampleTestCases.expected: Step 2 executes only for non-responders after exact 48-hour delay window.
sampleTestCases.actual: Condition correctly evaluated; replied leads excluded from step 2.

sampleTestCases.title: RBAC Verification: SDR Restricted from Bulk Lead Deletion
sampleTestCases.steps: Authenticate as SDR role; attempt direct UI delete and API DELETE request /api/v1/leads/bulk.
sampleTestCases.expected: UI action disabled; API returns 403 Forbidden with structured error payload.
sampleTestCases.actual: 403 Forbidden returned; audit log records unauthorized attempt.

sampleBug.steps:
1. Import CSV containing 500 leads with international special characters in name fields.
2. Trigger automated sequence with template variable {{first_name}}.
3. Inspect queue worker logs.
sampleBug.expected: UTF-8 encoding preserved, all 500 sequence jobs queued without error.
sampleBug.actual: Unescaped single quote in names caused worker process crash, dropping 142 leads from campaign.
sampleBug.impact: Would cause high lead loss and silent outreach failures in production. Caught and resolved prior to feature launch.

automation.pattern: API-driven test seeding with UI assertion validation
automation.ciIntegration: Postman Newman collection runs on every backend deployment.

results.regressionTimeSaved: Reduced end-to-end campaign testing from 12 hours to 2 hours
results.releaseQuality: Zero data leakage incidents across multi-tenant workspaces

learnings: RBAC and data-ingestion pipelines require automated API contract validation before UI testing to catch schema violations and permission flaws immediately.
